defs.def: not very great in amount or extent 有限的

ex.s: It was a valuable limited edition.
ex.t: 它是很有价值的限量版。

ex.s: Until recently, scientific evidence had been limited to one aspect of morality: kindness.
ex.t: 牢记你的听众。

ex.s: They had a very limited vocabulary.
ex.t: "如果他说的是实话怎么办？"他暗自思忖。

ex.s: They are limited in number.
ex.t: 它们数量有限。

ex.s: While many species’ thought processes are limited to “Food, eat it!”, “Danger, run!”, “Pain, avoid!”, we’ve evolved beyond that.
ex.t: 如果你想要过上更可持续的生活方式，很有可能你身边的人并不会立刻加入你的行列。

ex.s: Language capacity is limited by self-control.
ex.t: 语言能力受自控力限制。

ex.s: They shouldn’t be limited to a single method.
ex.t: 不应该局限于单一方法。

ex.s: Limited working space.
ex.t: 35.关于作者我们可以推断出什么？

ex.s: "Many people in China have limited exposure to English.
ex.t: "许多中国人接触英语的机会有限。

ex.s: Limited medical insurance coverage．
ex.t: 有限的医疗保险．

ex.s: on a limited budgetB. in high spirits
ex.t: 预算有限B. 情绪高涨

ex.s: Given a limited amount of money, a consumer can only spend that same amount buying goods.
ex.t: 如果消费者需要数量为A的商品花费0.75，那么她只能在购买B时花费剩余的0.25X。

ex.s: Parents ought to be able to opt out only for limited medical or religious reasons.
ex.t: 群体免疫在以下情况下运作良好__________。

ex.s: A thistle cannot grow." a As well as being good for the environment, gardening is also good for the soul b But in cities, limited space has led to people looking for new solutions.
ex.t: 蓟草不能生长。a 园艺不仅对环境有好处，对心灵也有好处。b 但在城市里，有限的空间让人们开始寻找新的解决方案。

ex.s: When first introduced in Japan in 1999, emojis were limited to 176 simple designs.
ex.t: 1999年首次在日本推出时，表情符号仅限于176种简单的设计。

ex.s: She believed that the chemical industry was knowingly causing harm to plants, animals and even humans, and wished to see pesticides used in a more responsible, limited and carefully monitored way.
ex.t: 她认为化学工业正在明知地给植物、动物甚至人类造成伤害，并希望看到农药以更负责任、有限和仔细监控的方式使用。

ex.s: On the whole, I do have to admit that here, people’s knowledge of Chinese literature is rather limited.
ex.t: 总的来说，我不得不承认，在这里，人们对中国文学的了解相当有限。

defs.def: restricted to a particular limit of time, numbers, etc. 受（ … 的）限制

ex.s: This includes, but is not limited to: visual art, graphic art, photography, poetry, short story, non-fiction, etc Submissions may be from existing or newly created work.
ex.t: 包括但不限于：视觉艺术、平面艺术、摄影、诗歌、短篇小说、非虚构作品等。投稿可以是已有作品或新创作的作品。

ex.s: Once we found the place, it was stressful getting lights and cameras set up in the limited time.
ex.t: 找到地点后，要在有限的时间内架好灯光和相机，压力很大。

ex.s: Once in front of the painting, they only have limited time to spend taking in its five metres of scenes along the Bian River in Bianjing.
ex.t: 一旦站在画前，他们只有有限的时间来欣赏它五米长的描绘汴京汴河沿岸景象的长卷。
